goal: Name the single most valuable improvement EXCAVA could make to how it presents results to its owner, and say concretely what to change.

judge.said:
ARTIFACT 2
The winner is more concrete and actionable because it specifies a "Top Insights" dashboard and an "Advanced View" toggle, providing clear design elements to implement.
